title: 8 Billion: Another Life — One life among eight billion
description: What if you were born somewhere else, in another time? Live a whole life shaped by chance and choices, across eleven worlds from 1950 to 2200.
headline:
Eight billion people.
One whole life.
intro:
What if you were born somewhere else, in another time?
Live a life from its first breath to its last chapter.
You never know where it will begin.
explore: What life is waiting for you? ↓
heroAlt: One person standing among a crowd of pixel characters
caption: Up close, a tragedy. From afar, a comedy.
birth: Country, era, family, circumstance: all decided by chance. Meet your parents and siblings, and see how children born at the very same moment elsewhere turn out.
birthQuestion: What life will this child live?
sample: Illustrative scenes from the world of the game.
moments: Everyday life unfolds on its own. A report everyone praised and a lunch gone cold. A gift for your parents from your first paycheck. Some days are funny, some are hard.
timeline: Started school. Made a friend on the first day.
First paycheck. Spent half on a gift for Mom.
Got married. It rained all day.
Promoted. The celebration lunch was ruined.
A grandchild’s first word: your name.
choice: University, work, moving abroad, marriage, a business of your own. Choices add up. Find a first chance in business, acting, singing, politics or sport, with setbacks and new starts along the way.
choicePrompt: A better opportunity has come up, but it means longer hours and more responsibility. Do you take it?
choiceNote: There is no single right answer to a life.
statsTitle: No single score for a life.
statsBody: Health, happiness, knowledge, relationships and the monthly budget. You can be wealthy and lonely, or short on money and still have joyful days.
worlds: Begin in 2026. Live a life to its end and another world opens. Find a new life in the history behind us and the possibilities ahead.
worldNote: Eleven worlds · Country statistics set the scene; they do not predict a real person’s life. Far-future worlds are imagined.
archive: Past lives gather in your archive and collection. Share a birth card as an image and look back on the lives you have lived. What remains is no total score, but what that person held on to, and the moments that passed them by.
faqs: Yes. Open new worlds by watching a short video, or buy Premium once to open them without ads.
There is no account and no sign-in. Your lives are saved on your device.
Can I change the pace or the wording of events?
You can adjust the speed and choose gentler wording for heavy events.
Characters and families are generated for the game. Country statistics set the scene for a life; they do not predict a real person’s life.
closing:
Who will you be
in your next life?
closingBody: Another era. Another country. A story you have yet to live.
